split: Equal-length first/last halves of whole disjoint one-second blocks; odd central block unused. Within each training half choose complexity by leave-one-block-out; do not select on test blocks. Both temporal directions must pass independently for a band to qualify.
fit: Represent S(f)/trace(S(f)) by a positive-semidefinite2x2 matrix per child frequency cell. Normalize each block by its own band trace, retain L/R power balance and complex conjugate(L)*R. Fit weighted child moments with a parent matrix pseudo-trace prior. Compare with one matrix per original band. Common spectral power is not fitted.
control_policy: Mono, independent balanced, stationary coloured-delay and sign/ILD-reversing halves at three seeds. At least four stationary-coloured bands qualify; no mono/independent/reversing band may qualify in both directions. Otherwise retain failed evidence and do not authorize a runtime model.
scope: Reuse manifest-bound raw stereo Welch blocks from reference_audit_v1; no new media or normalization/phase warp of source audio. Recorded transfer only, not physical-source separation, head geometry, true load or unseen-recording validation. No borrowing cabin width for A. A3block cases lack two training blocks and are reported as insufficient. A passing raw-recording covariance gate alone does not authorize adding a residual to an existing DNA, whose spectral debt may not be PSD. No C/model/UI/driver/take change or listening acceptance.
